deployments_detail.use: "AI-TAS" AI weld-line detection for welding robots (near-teachingless); "V-factory" IoT + AI research institute
AI and IoT-driven automated processing for metalworking machines
AI technologies for digital transformation and customer co-creation

AI-TAS auto weld-point correction on FLW-ENSISe fiber-laser welding robots: ML trained on weld-joint data detects real image vs 3D/CAD weld lines via camera and automatically corrects for setup misalignment and part variation, removing manual TAS teaching.
deployments_detail.value: ~46% production lead-time reduction and 74% processing-cost reduction vs conventional TIG welding

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven cutting-path optimization on next-gen fiber laser cutting machines (REGIUS-3015AJe) unveiled at JIMTOF 2024: AI determines the most efficient cutting path to reduce cutting time and maximize productivity.

i-Camera Assisted System (i-CAS): a centrally positioned camera images the whole laser-cutting bed and the system recognizes free areas/remnants to automatically nest parts onto the leftover material.

Establishment of AMADA AI Innovation Laboratory, a dedicated R&D subsidiary to acquire AI/advanced technologies for whole-production-process optimization, transfer of skilled-worker techniques, and machining support in sheet-metal fabrication.

V-factory IoT platform aggregating machine operation/production and consumable-degradation data to the cloud for analysis, enabling remote diagnostics and predictive maintenance (fault forecasting) of Amada machines at customer factories.

Benefitter generative-AI chatbot automating internal IT help desk inquiries (business systems, PC, network); indexes ~650 internal documents so employees self-resolve issues. Being extended to CAD software support and HR/admin inquiries. [CTC (Itochu Techno-Solutions) - Benefitter]
deployments_detail.value: Help desk operating hours cut by 3 hrs/day from July 2025; unanswered calls dropped from 50-100/month to under 50; 739 accesses in June 2025

deployments_detail.use: Enterprise generative-AI usage platform supporting two modes (public internet data with confidentiality/copyright safeguards, and internal-data-only) applied to IT/CAD helpdesk, HR inquiries, and quality-data retrieval across internal operations.
AI-based analysis of new-graduate recruiting entry sheets to evaluate candidates more objectively and multifaceted, surfacing challenging mindset/aptitude that human screeners might miss.

VPSS 4ie sheet-metal CAD/CAM software with AI drawing-assist function (AI作図支援機能) that automatically extracts and generates faces/unfolded drawings, letting inexperienced operators produce expert-level bending programs and shortening drawing-creation time.

AiBEND function in VPSS 3i BEND that captures veteran operators' bending know-how to automatically generate faster, higher-quality bending programs (skill transfer / de-skilling of bending programming).
